Name: Any-position AP diagnosis
Rule: ICD-9-CM 577.0 OR normalized ICD-10-CM code beginning K85 in any diagnosis position
Shared reference rules: No clinical-domain rule shared; diagnosis information may remain visible in source text

Name: Principal-position AP diagnosis
Rule: P0 code in the locally verified principal-diagnosis position (MIMIC seq_num=1)
Shared reference rules: No clinical-domain rule shared; diagnosis information may remain visible in source text

Name: Any-position code plus enzyme
Rule: P0 AND at least one lipase/amylase result from -24 to +48 h relative to admission with valuenum/ref_range_upper >=3.0
Shared reference rules: Shares enzyme items, ULN calculation, threshold, and window with the reference construction (partial circularity)

Name: Atlanta-like two-of-three rule
Rule: At least two positive domains among pain, enzyme >=3x row-specific ULN, and imaging; pain positive requires no pain-negation flag; frozen imaging implementation counts a positive flag even if a negative flag also occurs
Shared reference rules: Shares all three domains, lexicons, threshold, window, and decision structure (constructive circularity)

Name: Transparent evidence score
Role in this study: Canonicalization proved P4 logically equivalent to P3; retained only in specification and excluded as an independent comparator

Name: L2-regularized logistic implementation
Rule: Seven frozen features: any AP code, principal AP code, enzyme >=3xULN, normalized log maximum ULN multiple, pain flag, imaging flag, and pancreatitis-history flag; C=1.0, balanced classes, threshold 0.50
Shared reference rules: Shares enzyme, pain, and imaging inputs; fitted on 218 adjudicable development encounters with 39 positives
Role in this study: Excluded from main empirical comparison because event-per-feature support and inferential uncertainty were inadequate; specification retained for transparency
